_comment: 1. Claude Desktop does NOT inherit your shell PATH, so 'command' must be an
ABSOLUTE path to uv. Find it with:  which uv
2. --directory must be the absolute path to this jarvis folder.
Then quit Claude Desktop completely (Cmd-Q, not just close) and reopen it.
macOS will prompt for Automation/Files permissions the first time a tool runs;
those grants attach to Claude Desktop, and you will re-grant them if you later
run the same server from a terminal or a launchd agent.
